payload.purpose_context: Spec Kitty workspace preparation must atomically assert unchanged execution and eligibility authority in the same serialized transaction as workspace mutations. Same-byte writes fabricate revision churn, while current GapDB batches expose only mutations. This mission adds bounded, protocol-visible read assertions evaluated under the serialized writer before any mutation, with exact acknowledgement and crash/recovery semantics.
payload.purpose_tldr: Add first-class no-write transactional condition checks to GapDB for Spec Kitty authority guards.
